knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(purrr)
library(lme4)
library(lmerTest)
library(emmeans)
library(dplyr)
library(janitor)
library(car)
```

```{r}
zf <- read_csv("../Data/BPS_CELLCOUNT.csv")

zf <- zf %>%
  clean_names()

str(zf)
```

Selecting only one row per sumed value
```{r}
df_sum <- zf %>%
  group_by(plate, well, concentration_ug_l) %>%
  summarise(
    total_gfp = sum(total_gfp, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(total_gfp != 0)
```

ggplot of total gfp in thyroid follicles at 10
```{r}
gfp_cellcount_plot <- ggplot(
    df_sum,
    aes(
        x = factor(concentration_ug_l),
        y = log(total_gfp),
        color = factor(concentration_ug_l)
    )
) +
    
    # raw datapoints
    geom_jitter(
        width = 0.15,
        size = 2,
        alpha = 0.7
    ) +
    
    # mean points
    stat_summary(
        fun = mean,
        geom = "point",
        size = 3,
        color = "black"
    ) +
    
    # mean ± SE
    stat_summary(
        fun.data = mean_se,
        geom = "errorbar",
        width = 0.2,
        color = "black"
    ) +
    
    scale_color_brewer(palette = "Greens") +
    
    labs(
        x = "BPS Concentration (µg/L)",
        y = "log(Total GFP intensity (A.U.))",
        color = "BPS Concentration (µg/L)"
    ) +
    
    theme_bw()

plot(gfp_cellcount_plot)
```

```{r}
ggsave(
  filename = "../Figures/cellcount_gfp.png",
  plot = gfp_cellcount_plot,
  width = 8,
  height = 4,
  dpi = 300
)
```
